description: This file contains utility functions for generating C++ code and CMake files related to PyTorch's AOTInductor models, including functions to generate main.cpp content and CMakeLists.txt for building model-related executables.

methods.name: _get_main_cpp_file
methods.description: Generates the content of a main.cpp file for AOTInductor models, including code to load models, inputs, run inference, and save outputs.

methods.name: _get_make_file
methods.description: Generates a CMakeLists.txt content for building the main.cpp executable with appropriate dependencies based on CUDA or HIP support.
